directive.quote: finish the source-repo-a port so the repo can be retired and renamed source-repo-a-completely-ported

targets.baseline_commit_message: media-composition: byte copies of the three local sound-effect model scripts

preserve: sections merge into windows of at most the model's limit and a longer section splits in equal parts
each window is cut from the picture under the render lock, scored from picture and prompt, and padded or cut to exactly its length
5 ms fades at each seam, so every sample keeps its film time
one stem per seed, with what it was made from beside it
allowed_deltas: section starts, prompt, negative prompt, code and weights folders, steps, guidance and the lock folder are arguments (the person's settings) instead of a cue plan file and constants
banned_substitutions: a second video-to-sound runner beside make-pictures-and-sounds.mjs
